The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Friday, December 1, 1933

Rowdies Here Attack
Office Of Society Said
Backing Fukien Rebels

Hammers Shatter Show Cases Of Shenchow
Kuokwang Publishing Concern Owned
By Revolting General

Clash Looms On Chekiang Border

The Shenchow Kuokwang Publishing Society, alleged Socialist
Democratic propaganda organ under General Chen Ming-shu,
independence leader in Fukien, was made a target of attack by
local rowdies, believed to be elements of Fascist organizations,
at 7 o'clock last night.
A youth, clad in long gown, entered the bookstore at 136
Honan Road, pretending to be a customer, according to the shop-
assistants today. When he reached the counter, he gave a signal,
promptly responded to by three rowdies. They started wrecking
the premises, shattering the show
cases with hammers and escaped
before the arrival of police officers.
Police Arrest Youth
A Chinese policeman, however,
accosted a youth clad in long gown
at corner of Honan and Siking
Roads. He was bleeding and it was
alleged that he was the man who
first entered the bookstore. It also
was said that his head was cut by
flying glass while hammering a
show case.
Taken to the station, the youth
emphatically denied the charge,
adding that he received in the in-
jury accidentally as a piece of glass
fell on his forehead. He was dis-
missed at the police station as no
incriminating evidence could be
found against him.
It is understood that no alarm
was raised by the shop-assistants
during or after the attack.

（批：Please note and
pass W Reg. to file.
J.K.）

本地暴徒袭击
据称支持福建叛军的
社团办事处

铁锤砸碎神州国光社陈列柜
该出版社为叛变将军所有

浙江边境冲突一触即发

昨晚 7 时，据称隶属于福建独立运动领袖陈铭枢将军的社会民主党宣传机构——神州国光社，成为本地暴徒的袭击目标，这些暴徒被认为是法西斯组织的成员。
据店员今日称，一名身穿长衫的青年假装顾客进入河南路 136 号的书店。当他走到柜台前时，发出信号，三名暴徒随即响应。他们开始破坏店内设施，用铁锤砸碎陈列柜，并在警察到达之前逃离。
警方逮捕一名青年
然而，一名中国巡捕在河南路与四泾路（Siking Roads，音译）拐角处拦住了一名身穿长衫的青年。该青年正在流血，据称他就是首先进入书店的人。还据说他在用铁锤砸陈列柜时，被飞溅的玻璃划伤了头部。
该青年被带到警局后，坚决否认指控，并补充说他的伤是意外造成的，当时一块玻璃掉在他的额头上。由于找不到对他不利的证据，他在警察局被释放。
据悉，在袭击期间或之后，店员均未报警。

（批注：请知悉并将 W Reg. 归档。J.K.）

December 1, 3.

Political (3)

Attack on propaganda organ of Social Democratic
Party - book shop smashed

At 7 p.m. November 30, four Chinese entered the
Shun Chow Kuo Kwan; Zoe, a Book Shop at 136 Honan Road,
and after cutting the telephone wire smashed a show
window and cupboard. The miscreants subsequently
departed leaving behind paper slips bearing anti-Communist
and pro-Chiang Kai-shek slogans. A male Chinese who was
in the shop at the time was suspected of being one of the
trouble makers and was arrested by the police but subse-
quently released for lack of evidence against him.

This book shop is suspected of being a propaganda
organ of the Social Democratic Party of which General
Chen Ling-chu (陳銘樞) one of the principal promoters
of the Fukien Incident, is the leader.

政治 (3)

社会民主党宣传机构遭袭——书店被砸

11 月 30 日晚 7 时，四名中国人进入位于河南路 136 号的神州国光社书店，切断电话线后砸碎了展示窗和橱柜。肇事者随后离开，留下了印有反共和拥蒋口号的纸条。当时在店内的一名中国男子涉嫌为滋事者之一，被警方逮捕，但因缺乏对其不利的证据而随后获释。

该书店涉嫌为社会民主党的宣传机构，该党由福建事变的主要发起人之一陈铭枢将军领导。

          Anti Communists Disturbance at a book-
          shop situated at No.136 Honan Rd.

    At 7 p.m. 30.11.33, one Yang Kyi Ts (        ), 23,
Student, native of Szechuen, who arrived from Nanking
yesterday in order to locate relative, entered a book-
shop, No.136 Honan Road, and purchased three books:
one on Finance, one on the Box Rebellion, and a novel,
for which he paid $1.70.  As he was about to leave the
shop 4 other males, speaking Shanghai dialect entered and
immediately commenced to smash the book cases and tore
the telephone from the wall.  After doing damage to the
approximately value of $150.00, the four men then made
good their escapes.  During the confusion Yang received
cuts from broken glass on his head and hands and as he was
concerned with the others in smashing the cases and had
him arrested by C.P.C.s who were in the vicinity.  After
these men had left the shop a number of anti-Communist
pamphlets were found on the floor..  Copies of which are
attached hereto.  There was no evidence to show that Yang
had anything to do with the persons who did the damage.

          河南路 136 号一家书店发生反共骚乱。

    1933 年 11 月 30 日晚 7 时，杨义之（Yang Kyi Ts，音译），23 岁，学生，四川籍，昨日从南京抵达以寻找亲属，进入河南路 136 号的一家书店，购买了三本书：一本关于金融，一本关于义和团运动，以及一本小说，共计付款 1.70 元。当他正要离开书店时，另外四名讲上海话的男子进入，并立即开始砸碎书柜，将电话从墙上扯下。在造成约 150.00 元的损失后，这四名男子逃之夭夭。在混乱中，杨的头部和手部被碎玻璃划伤，由于他与其他人一起砸柜子，被附近的华捕逮捕。这些人离开书店后，在地板上发现了一些反共小册子。副本附后。没有证据表明杨与实施破坏的人员有任何关系。

Date December 21, 1933.
Subject (in full) Attack on Bookstores.
Made by and Forwarded by D. S. I. Duncan.

With reference to attached reports dated November 20
and December 15 made by D.S. Pitts on the above subject,
diligent enquiries have been kept up by the staff of S.1
but nothing definite can be ascertained regarding the
so-called "上海電影界剋共團 Shanghai Cinema Circles Communist Extermination
Association" or the persons responsible for the attacks
on the bookstores.
While it is reasonable to believe that ex-graduates
of the Whampoa Military Academy who may be members of the
"Blue Shirts Society", engineered the attacks on the Nee
Hwa Motion Picture Studio and the Liang Yue Bookstore,
no proof of this has been forthcoming and it is more likely
that a few irresponsible students with ultra-patriotic ideas
were the guilty parties.
Such an Association as above mentioned, being
of an anti-Communist character would undoubtedly have at
least the moral support of local Government officials.
Nothing further has been heard of the Association since the
attack on the Shun Chow Kuo Kwang Dzoe (神州國光社) Bookstore,
136 Honan Road, on November 30 and it appears as if its
activities have come to an end.

of a radical nature.

Made by...... D.S. Pitts.          Forwarded by... Wrounson ASS

In compliance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch regarding offences which have recently been
perpetrated against radical newspapers and bookstores, I have
to report that careful enquiries reveal the following information.
Two attacks only have been made on bookstores which might
be classed as radical in a very modified degree, whilst a third
assault was perpetrated against premises housing a communistic
publication's printing plant.
The first incident occurred at 12.5 p.m. November 12, 1933
at the Liang Yue (良友) Bookstore, No. 851 North Szechuen
Road when the plate-glass show-window of the shop was smashed by
some person or persons unknown, who employed an iron hammer-head
as the means of destruction.
The Liang Yue Bookstore is a Cantonese concern which was
established some seven or eight years ago. The general publi-
cations of this company are of a pictorial nature whilst books
in the new Chinese literary style and topical talking films'
song sheets form the bulk of the sales. The manager of this
firm is one named Wu Lien-teh (伍連德), a graduate of the
Lin Nan (南) University, Canton; he originally joined
the Commercial Press as a draughtsman and held that position
until he established the Liang Yue Bookstore.
On November 15, the above mentioned company received a threat-
ening letter, a translation of which is attached, dated November
13, 1933 from an organisation styling itself "Shanghai Cinema
Circles Communist Extermination Association." This communicat-
ion warned the bookstore not to print or publish any literature
of a radical or reactionary nature and instructed the management
to refrain from offering for sale books written by various "red"

遵照特科主管警官关于近期针对激进报纸和书店所犯罪行的指示，我谨报告，经仔细调查，获悉以下信息。
仅有两起针对可被归类为具有轻微激进性质的书店的袭击事件，而第三起袭击则是针对一家共产主义刊物印刷厂所在的场所。
第一起事件发生于 1933 年 11 月 12 日下午 12:05，地点为四川北路 851 号的良友图书公司，店内的平板玻璃展示窗被身份不明的一人或多人用铁锤头砸碎。
良友图书公司是一家广东商号，成立于七八年前。该公司的一般出版物多为画报性质，而新文学风格的书籍和时事有声电影的歌篇构成了销售的大部分。该公司的经理名为伍连德，毕业于广州岭南大学；他最初加入商务印书馆担任绘图员，直至创办良友图书公司前一直担任该职。
11 月 15 日，上述公司收到一封恐吓信，译文附后，日期为 1933 年 11 月 13 日，来自一个自称“上海电影界克共团”的组织。该信函警告书店不得印刷或出版任何激进或反动性质的文献，并指示管理层停止出售由各种“红色”

The Shun Chow Quo Kwang Toe was established in 1929 by five Chinese, prominent among whom was General Chen Ming-chu (陳銘樞) who subscribed 60% of the total capital amounting to $380,000 necessary to float the company, which is suspected of being a propaganda organ of the Social Democratic Party of which Chen Ming-chu, one of the principal Promoters of the Fukien Secessionist Movement, is the leader. This was brought about by the fact that when the company was under the management of Tseng Hsien Sung (曾聲) an intimate friend of Chen Ming-chu, Wong Li Shih (王礼錫) one of the most prominent members of the Anti-Bolshevik Group joined the Bookstore through the recommendation of Deu Sih Ban (段錫朋), Vice Minister of Education. Shortly after Wong became Chief Editor of the Bookstore in 1930 he succeeded in effecting a compromise with the Elimination Clique of the Communist Party, of which the aged Chen Tu Siu (陳獨秀), now undergoing a term of imprisonment, was the Chief. By this compromise members of the Elimination Clique agreed to cooperate with the Anti-Bolshevik Group in launching a propaganda campaign hostile to the Stalin Clique as well as other political organisations not seeing eye-to-eye with their doctrines.

The only instance which has come to the notice of the Municipal Police of an offence perpetrated against bookstores strongly supporting the Kuomintang is that in which an attack was made on the Hsin Kwang (新光) Bookstore, No. 88 Burkill Road at 3.30 p.m. November 13, 1933 by six young Chinese males of the student class. Full details of this outrage are as follows:

The Hsin Kwang Bookstore has for more than a year acted as the general distribution agent for the "Social News" (社会新闻), a bi-weekly mosquito publication which devotes its pages to the exposing of reactionary elements and to advocating national unity. It is definitely of an anti-communist nature and attempts to show its readers the fallacies and drawbacks of the "red" doctrine. Although only a mosquito paper it enjoys a fairly large circulation and is well received locally. The paper has its editorial and printing offices at the Social News Agency at premises located next to the Headquarters of the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang, West Gate, Nantao, its editor being one Ting Muh Tsung (丁默村), a reformed communist. Although it has not been definitely ascertained, it is believed that this publication is subsidized by the local Kuomintang authorities so that the latter's views on the failings of radicalism may be broadcast.

Toiling Youth Masses !

The "Social News" is the Press organ of the Kuo-
mintang, being employed as a means to deceive the masses
and is the manufacturing centre of various 'reactionary'
news. It is the deadly enemy of labourers, peasants
and other toilers.
The "Social News" advocates reconciliation between
workers and capitalists, exhorting the former to toler-
ate and not resist the oppression of the Kuomintang
and the Capitalists.
The "Social News" disseminates fascist doctrines and
instils 'reactionary' militarist ideas.
The "Social News" blackmails the anti-Japanese and
anti-imperialist Soviet Government and the Red Army.
It labels the Soviet Union as the Red "imperialists"
and opposed the fraternal alliance of the Chinese rev-
olutionary masses with the Soviet Union. It also
publishes reports shielding the traitorous acts of
the Kuomintang.
The "Social News" requests the technical co-oper-
ation of the robber League of Nations and the partition-
ing of China by the imperialists.
In order to ensure the success of revolutionary
wars and to overthrow the present 'reactionary' regime,
we must smash all political deceits of the Kuomintang.
We summon the youth masses to crush anti-revolutionary
societies and to organise corps to punish the editors
and responsible persons of the "Social News" - the
White Terror Fascist publication.
Bury all arbitrary propaganda and political deceits
of the Kuomintang !
Long live the Chinese Communist Party !
Long live the Chinese Soviet !

Kiangsu Provincial Committee
of the
Chinese Communist Youth League.
November 13, 1933.

劳苦青年大众！

《社会新闻》是国民党的新闻机关，被用作欺骗群众的手段，是各种“反动”新闻的制造中心。它是工人、农民和其他劳动者的死敌。
《社会新闻》主张工人与资本家和解，劝告前者容忍并不抵抗国民党和资本家的压迫。
《社会新闻》散布法西斯主义学说，灌输“反动”军国主义思想。
《社会新闻》勒索抗日反帝的苏维埃政府和红军。它将苏联标榜为红色“帝国主义者”，反对中国革命群众与苏联的兄弟联盟。它还发表掩护国民党叛国行为的报道。
《社会新闻》请求强盗国际联盟的技术合作，以及帝国主义对中国的瓜分。
为了确保革命战争的成功并推翻当前的“反动”政权，我们必须粉碎国民党的所有政治欺骗。我们号召青年大众粉碎反革命社团，并组织队伍惩罚《社会新闻》——白色恐怖法西斯刊物的编辑和负责人。
埋葬国民党所有的任意宣传和政治欺骗！
中国共产党万岁！
中华苏维埃万岁！

中国共产主义青年团
江苏省委

由 督察 顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）制作 经由 A. G. Burnett 转呈

鉴于随附的1933年12月13日上海公共
安全局（Public Safety Bureau）局长文鸿恩
（Wen Hung-en）将军发出的标有“法”字、
编号1595的公函，内容涉及1933年11月17日
当地共产党人袭击南京路619号百胜（Pai
Shen (百勝.)）电刻店一事，现陈述如下：
尽管我方知晓上述暴行系由当地中国共产党
“飞行队”成员所为，该等队伍主要由失业工人
组成，但经本处职员勤勉努力，迄今仍未能查明
参与袭击者的真实身份。进一步调查正在进行中，
若获得任何补充信息，将另行提交报告。

顾宝华
督察

特务科主管警官。

At 7.30 p.m. 17-11-53, complainant came
to this Station with a piece of stone wrapped up
in a piece of white paper bearing Chinese charac-
ters, copy of translation is attached hereto, and
reported that at 7.15 p.m., same date, it had been
thrown through one of the plate glass windows of
a silver ware shop at 319 Nanking Road, by a
person unknown, who escaped unseen by the occu-
pants of the shop. D.S. Logan and C.D.C.105
visited the scene and found a large plate glass
window damaged to the extent of $100.00. The
shop in question is situated on the South side
of Nanking Road almost directly opposite the inter-
section of Lloyd Road, where C.P.C.2466 was posted
on point duty some 30 yards distant but the latter
though he heard the smashing of the window pane
did not see any person running from the scene and
was not able to single out any suspicious person
in the vicinity at the time due to the density of
the crowds walking on the pavement. Inquiries
made by C.P.C.2466 immediately after the occur-
rence failed to locate a witness of the offence
as also did enquiries made in the vicinity by
D.S. Logan and C.D.C.105.

The malicious damage would appear to be
the work of Communists inspired by the action of
complainant and various other shopkeepers exhibit-
ing in their shop windows, posters denouncing the
Communists and asking for support for the Nanking
Government.

1933年11月17日*下午7时30分，投诉人
来到本捕房，带来一块用白纸包裹的石
头，纸上写有中文字符，译文副本附后，
并报告称同日晚上7时15分，该石头被一
名不明身份者透过南京路319号*一家银器
店的一块平板玻璃窗扔入，此人趁店内人
员不备逃脱。警佐洛根（Logan）和刑事侦
缉员105号（C.D.C.105）前往现场，发现一
块大型平板玻璃窗受损，损失达100.00美
元。涉案店铺位于南京路南侧，几乎正对
劳合路（Lloyd Road）交叉口，当时巡捕
2466号（C.P.C.2466）在约30码外执行定点
执勤，虽然听到了玻璃破碎声，但未看见
任何人从现场跑开，且由于人行道上人群
密集，当时无法辨认出附近的任何可疑人
员。巡捕2466号在事发后立即进行的查询，
以及警佐洛根和刑事侦缉员105号在附近进
行的查询，均未能找到本案目击证人。

此次恶意破坏似乎是共产党人所为，
其动机是受到投诉人及其他各种店主在店
窗展示谴责共产党并呼吁支持南京政府的
海报这一行为的刺激。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

At 9.18 p.m., same date, a telephone message
was received from C.C.R. to the effect that communists
were expected to throw stones through windows in the
vicinity of Dong Chong (同昌) Cycle Shop and Sun Ya
(新雅) Restaurant. On receipt of the message Chinese
detectives were detailed to patrol in the vicinity of
these places.

When first questioned by detectives complain-
ant denied having had any quarrel with any person who-
soever or that any person might harbour a grudge against
his shop, also his having any political leanings which
might arouse malice in any quarter, but at 8.45 p.m.
same date, he returned to the station and stated that
for about a fortnight his shop had been having some
difficulty with a customer who was dissatisfied with
a wireless set bought at complainant's shop and suggest-
ed that this person might be the culprit. The suspect-
ed person, one named Li (李), is believed to reside in
the vicinity of Gordon Road; enquiries are being made
with a view to locating him and investigating the
possibility of his being the guilty party. Circulated.

Kuo Ming Tang Party or Communist Party? Who caused the bankruptcy

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

At 6.15p.m. on the 2/12/37, one named Kiang Wei 'yi (江維一), an assistant in the employ of complainant, reported to Station that at 5.25p.m. on the 2/12/37, a telephone message had been received from an unknown source, which asked the following question:-
"Does your shop want a bomb".
This telephone call was taken by a foreman in complainant's employ, named Wong Chih Kwei (王志貴) and he states that nothing else was said by the person sending the message.
Voice was that of a male Chinese, and of deep tone, probably assumed for the occasion and witness was unable to identify it with any person of his acquaintance.
Further enquiries at the scene of offence proved futile, but as a precaution against any violence being attempted by the offenders, Police were again placed on guard in the vicinity.
It was omitted from Diary No.3 that Police who had been placed on duty on receipt of the initial report were withdrawn at the complainant's request.

Political (6)

Sing Ming Publishing Society - threatened with bombing

The Sing Ming Publishing Society, 117 Nan Ching
Road, Shanhaikwan Road, received a telephone call from
an unknown source at 5.30 p.m. December 2. The call
stated "You will be bombed. Do you want it".

It will be recalled that this concern is the
printing office of the Chen Pao, one of the local
vernacular papers which received on November 15 through
the post a threatening letter from the "Warm Blood and
Heat Group". The Chen Pao is believed to be a Kuomintang
organ operated by Pan Kung-chai (潘公展), Chief of the
Bureau of Education and a committee member of the local
Tangpu.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by [签名]

In compliance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch appearing on the attached translation from the
China Times dated November 14, 1933 entitled "Communist handbills
distributed on Burkill Road," I have to report that enquiries
elicit the following information:-

The Hsin Kwang Bookstore with premises situated at No. 88
Burkill Road has for more than a year acted as the general dis-
tribution agent for the "Social News" (社会新闻), a bi-weekly
mosquito paper which devotes its pages to the exposing of react-
ionary elements and to advocating national unity. It is def-
initely of an anti-communist nature and attempts to show its
readers the fallacies and drawbacks of the "red" doctrine.
Although only a mosquito paper it enjoys a fairly large circu-
lation and is well received locally. The paper has its
editorial and printing offices at the Social News Agency at
premises located next to the headquarters of the Shanghai
Special District Kuomintang, West Gate, Nantao, its editor
being one Ting Muh Tsung (丁默村), a reformed communist.
Although it has not been definitely ascertained, it is believed
that this publication receives some sort of financial support
from the local Kuomintang authorities so that the latter's
views on the failings of radicalism can be broadcast.

At 3.30 p.m. November 13, 1933 two young Chinese males of the
student type entered the front door of the Hsin Kwang Bookstore
and stated that they wished to subscribe to the Social News.
One of these individuals gave his name as Wong Ts Dee (王志田)
and declared that he was a student at the Great China University,
off Kiaochow Road, O.O.L. Almost immediately afterwards
four similar youths entered the shop, one asking to be allowed

Toiling Youth Masses !

The "Social News" is the Press organ of the Kuo-
mintang, being employed as a means to deceive the masses
and is the manufacturing centre of various 'reactionary'
news. It is the deadly enemy of labourers, peasants
and other toilers.
The "Social News" advocates reconciliation between
workers and capitalists, exhorting the former to toler-
ate and not resist the oppression of the Kuomintang
and the Capitalists.
The "Social News" disseminates fascist doctrines and
instils 'reactionary' militarist ideas.
The "Social News" blackmails the anti-Japanese and
anti-Imperialist Soviet Government and the Red Army.
It labels the Soviet Union as the Red "imperialists"
and opposed the fraternal alliance of the Chinese rev-
olutionary masses with the Soviet Union. It also
publishes reports shielding the traitorous acts of
the Kuomintang.
The "Social News" requests the technical co-oper-
ation of the robber League of Nations and the partition-
ing of China by the imperialists.
In order to ensure the success of revolutionary
wars and to overthrow the present 'reactionary' regime,
we must smash all political deceits of the Kuomintang.
We call on the youth masses to crush anti-revolutionary
societies and to organise corps to punish the editors
and responsible persons of the "Social News" - the
White Terror Fascist publication.
Bury all arbitrary propaganda and political deceits
of the Kuomintang !
Long live the Chinese Communist Party !
Long live the Chinese Soviet !

Kiangsu Provincial Committee
of the

劳苦青年大众们！

《社会新闻》是国民党的新闻机关，被用作欺骗大众的手段，是各种“反动”新闻的制造中心。它是工人、农民和其他劳动者的死敌。

为了确保革命战争的胜利并推翻当前的“反动”政权，我们必须粉碎国民党的所有政治欺骗。我们号召青年大众粉碎反革命社团，并组织队伍惩罚《社会新闻》——白色恐怖法西斯刊物的编辑和负责人。

COMMUNIST HANDBILLS DISTRIBUTED ON BURKILL ROAD
The Society Mercury (社會新聞), a mosquito news-paper, for the sale of which the Sin Kwang Bookstore (新光書局), at Burkill Road, is the general agent, has been published for more than a year. As the paper is devoted to exposing nefarious schemes of reactionaries and to advocating unity in the country, it is well received by the reading public and its circulations has become nation-wide. Therefore, the paper is offensive to the reactionaries.
The people responsible for the publication are, however, well aware of the intentions of the reactionaries and have removed their editorial office to Nantao, keeping the location of the office secret.
Yesterday, at 3.30 p.m. about twenty persons, all young men and poorly dressed, appeared in front of the Sin Kwang Bookstore on Burkill Road near Thibet Road. They blocked the traffic and distributed hundreds of leaflets bearing the title "Destroy the Fascist anti-revolutionary newspaper The Society Mercury."
The pamphlet states that the Society Mercury is the official organ of the Kuomintang and that the party is cheating the people. The paper, it continues, is the bitterest enemy of masses of workmen and farmers. It adds that the Society Mercury advocates harmony between capitalist and labourer and advises the labourers to bear the oppression of the capitalist Kuomintang. The leaflets bear the name "The Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Communist Party."
A reporter of this journal paid a visit yesterday to the book shop and was informed by one of the assistants that the shop assistants were not molested by the people and that activities of the rowdies were confined to the street.
The speaker assured the reporter that the book store is only an agent for the distribution of the paper and that the demonstration staged by the communists had nothing to do with the shop.

伯基尔路分发共产主义传单
《社会新闻》（社會新聞）是一家小型报刊，伯基尔路的新光书局（新光書局）是其总代理，该报已出版一年多。由于该报致力于揭露反动派的阴谋并倡导国家统一，因此受到读者欢迎，发行量已遍及全国。因此，该报令反动派感到恼火。
然而，负责出版该报的人员深知反动派的意图，已将编辑部迁至南市，并对办公地点保密。
昨天下午3时30分，约二十人，均为衣着破旧的年轻男子，出现在靠近西藏路的伯基尔路新光书局门前。他们阻塞交通，分发了数百份题为“捣毁法西斯反革命报纸《社会新闻》”的传单。
小册子称，《社会新闻》是国民党的官方机关报，该党正在欺骗人民。文章接着说，该报是广大工农群众最凶恶的敌人。文章还补充说，《社会新闻》提倡资本家与工人之间的和谐，并劝告工人忍受国民党资本家的压迫。传单署名为“共产党江苏省委员会”。
本报一名记者昨天走访了该书店，据一名店员告知，店员未受到这些人的骚扰，暴徒的活动仅限于街道。
发言人向记者保证，书店仅是该报纸的分销代理，共产党组织的示威活动与书店无关。

Sir,
I beg to report, that with reference to the above, D.I. Telfer,
D.I. Brownrigg, J.D.J.I. Shih and the undersigned made further
enquiries at the Liang Yue bookshop, No. 851 North Szechuen Road.
The master, Woo Liang Dah (伍聯達) was interviewed, and he denied
having printed or exposed for sale in his shop, any literature of
a Communistic nature, or taking part in any Communistic activities.
He gave permission for his shop and printing plant to be inspected
by the above mentioned detectives, but nothing of a Communistic
nature was found. He has on sale a number of books dealing with
the Russian 5 Year Plan, but they are not of a Communistic nature,
and he has permission from the Nanking Government to sell the same.
On making a more thorough inspection of the show window where
the plate glass pane was smashed, a newly made iron hammer head was
found, this was evidently the missile used to smash the window.
Enquiries will be made by detectives at all local iron foundries,
in an effort to locate the source of same.
There is not the slightest reason to suspect the master of the
Liang Yue bookshop of being engaged in Communistic activities, and
it is suspected that the attack on his shop is the outcome of
business rivalries, the culprits working under the anti-Red cloak,
to screen their activities. The master of the shop was questioned
re this, but stated that he could think of none of his business
rivals, who would go to such extremes.
A C.P.C. has been posted in the vicinity of the shop, with orders
to arrest any person acting suspiciously in the vicinity.

I am, Sir,

TRANSLATION FROM THE ZUNG PAO (民 報) DATED 13/11/33

The Nyi Woo Company was smashed.

Recently a new film company was established called
the Nyi Woo Company. This Company was established by
Chinese merchants. Dien Han and Loh Wan Chong were
engaged as managers. Kyung Yan and Woo Ping were
engaged as actors. They are now busily engaged in
taking pictures.

At about 9 a.m. yesterday morning the new
establishment of the Nyi Woo Company on Connaught Road
was entered by several tens of persons who smashed
everything up and distributed some white handbills
bearing the characters - "Arise and extinguish the
communists". "Arise and extinguish the communists who
commit slaughters and arsons". Knock down the communists
who betrayed our people." At the same time some printed
literature was distributed, which bears the name of the
Chinese Cinema members association for extinguishing the
communists. The literature states the Nyi Woo company
is a communistic propaganda organ. They are now petitioned
to the Bureau of Education, Bureau of Domestic affairs,
Central Kuomintang headquarters and the Great Municipality
of Shanghai, requesting them to instruct the said company
to destroy all their pictures and also to punish the red
members. They also declared that the action taken by them
yesterday morning was only a warning to the other companies,
if they don't change their attitude in future, more vigorous
action will be taken. It is also learned that they also
smashed the Liang Yue Book Store and Kwong Hwa book company
as these two establishments are also communistic organs.
The reporter made enquiries at the two latter establishments
but they denied having had any trouble yesterday morning.

Subject (in full) Smashing of shop window of the Liang Yue bookshop situated at No.851 North Szechuen Road.

Made by D.S.Glanville, Forwarded by Det.Inspr. A.Telfer.

Sir,
At about 12.15 p.m. 12/11/33, an assistant in a exchange shop situated at No.847 North Szechuen Road, heard the sound of glass being broken in the adjoining shop, No.851, the Liang Yue bookshop, so he went out and found that some unknown person had smashed the plate glass window of these premises. He did not see anyone running away from the scene. The sound of breaking glass was also heard by an assistant of the bookshop, one Lee Ching Kwong (李權慶), who at the time was in a back room having his tiffin, he also rushed out, but could see no one. In the doorway of the shop was found a quantity of small pamphlets, with a slogan printed in Chinese on them (attached). The translation is as follows:-
"Union of the people for the suppression of Communists."
The shop assistant reported the matter to C.P.C.1371, who reported the matter to the station. Enquiries were made by the undersigned and C.D.C.116, when the following was learned. The Liang Yue bookshop is closed on Sunday, and there is only one shop assistant left in charge of the premises, the master Woo Liang Dah (伍聯德), and the other assistants, living out. The assistant does not know where his master lives, except that he thinks it is on Yuen Yuen Road. He does not know whether his master is interested in any political party, but stated that there were some Russian books, translated into Chinese; on sale at the shop.
D.S.Moore of the Political Branch was informed of the occurrence.
The master of the shop will be interviewed on the morning of the 13/11/33.
Enquiries proceeding.

Following the attack made by a crowd of rowdies dressed like workmen on the Nee Hwa Motion Picture Company's new studio (藝華公司) at Connaught Road at 9 a.m. on Sunday and the distribution of leaflets bearing the name of the Chinese Motion Picture Employees Federation for the Extermination of Communists, a second attack was made yesterday at 11 p.m. on the Liang You Publishing Co. at 851 North Szechuen Road.
At the hour mentioned, a man carrying an iron bar in his hands appeared in front of the premises and smashed a large window, afterwards making good his escape.
Upon receipt of a report regarding the attack police from Hongkew Station rushed to the scene and made an investigation.
It is generally thought that the attack on the Nee Hwa Motion Picture Co. is related to the attempt made on the Liang You Publishing Co. inasmuch as both places are suspected of propagating communism.
When the incident which occurred at the Liang You Publishing Co. became known, the Kwang Hwa Book Store at Foochow Road became alarmed and made an appeal to the Central Police Station for protection.
Yesterday the Liang You Publishing Co. sent the following letter, but we are not certain whether the letter was despatched before or after the attack was made.
"Yesterday the news that the Nee Hwa Co. was wrecked appeared in the columns of your paper, and the name of our company was mentioned.

良友图书公司遭袭

继周日上午9时一群装扮成工人的暴徒袭击位于康纳路（Connaught Road）的艺华影片公司新制片厂，并散发署名为“中国电影界铲共同志会”的传单之后，昨日晚11时，四川北路851号的良友图书公司遭到第二次袭击。
在上述时刻，一名手持铁棍的男子出现在该处所门前，砸碎了一扇大窗户，随后成功逃脱。
接到有关此次袭击的报告后，虹口巡捕房的警察迅速赶赴现场进行调查。
人们普遍认为，对艺华影片公司的袭击与针对良友图书公司的企图有关，因为这两处地方均被怀疑宣传共产主义。
当良友图书公司发生的事件为人所知后，福州路的光华书局感到恐慌，并向中央巡捕房请求保护。
昨日，良友图书公司寄出以下信件，但我们不确定该信是在袭击发生之前还是之后发出的。
“昨日贵报刊登了艺华公司被毁的消息，并提及了我公司名称。
